lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The session ends in shouting, then in an evacuation, then in nothing at all. The floor does not sit again that month.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Six months later the Handover is enacted by executive order, unamended, unread, and unopposed. Vesely's post is abolished in the same instrument.

lines.speaker: mara_vesely
lines.text: You stopped a vote. You did not stop a treaty. Those are not the same object and I spent four years learning the difference.
